cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate by C1: defining anionic Sodium Laureth Sulfate @2 with prominent buffers Cocamidopropyl Betaine @3 and Coco-Glucoside @10, no reinforcing strong anionic. Laureth-2 @17 is a low-EO thickener (not a route).

conditioningLevel.rationale: High by C2: prominent payload lipid Argania Spinosa Kernel Oil @7 in place of a silicone, cationic Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride @8, pearlizing route Glycol Distearate @15, humectant Glycerin @5; reinforced by the quaternary conditioner Bis-(Isostearoyl/Oleoyl Isopropyl) Dimonium Methosulfate @9, Hydrolyzed Wheat Protein @6 and Hydrogenated Castor Oil @16. Counter-signal: no silicone; the care routes follow Sodium Chloride @4 and are likely each low-dose; moderate is the neighbor.

excluded: Prunus Amygdalus Dulcis Flower Extract @11, Pisum Sativum Sprout Extract @12 (botanicals)

weightPotential.counterevidence: Four deposition families converge fairly early (protein @6, argan oil @7, guar @8, quaternary conditioner @9) and W-RICH holds (material argan oil + cationic partners); a waxy Hydrogenated Castor Oil @16 adds persistence. This argues for high.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: Material lipid, a cationic guar, a quaternary conditioner and a protein plausibly leave noticeable residue, but on an effective buffered SLES chassis that bounds it.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not high: the rich route needs limited reset, but resetCapacity is moderate (C1 SLES with two buffers); there is no silicone, each depositing member follows Sodium Chloride @4 and is likely low-dose, and the protein is a weakly retained film, so the convergence is judged offset by reset. Not low: multiple families incl. a material lipid and cationics (W2).
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: Convergence of four families with W-RICH under moderate reset is close to the high boundary; high is the realistic neighbor.
weightPotential.rationale: Moderate: W-RICH (argan @7, HCO @16 + guar @8, quat @9) plus protein @6, offset by moderate C1 reset; neighbor high.
